body: Considering the current update strategy of Firefox, I think these versions would die out by the time when I implemented Firefox-only extensions with boringssl, so currently there is no plan to support them.

Everything else was made so I could have this, btw since the comment says that Firefox does not enable this, I believe it would also be fixed, since I've follow the same defaults as `tls_session_ticket` and it turns out to be `false` for non-chrome.

Was this done in response to https://github.com/yifeikong/curl_cffi/issues/323#issuecomment-2162907205 ?

Doesn't this change have security implications?
It was pushed simply for CI testing. There will be a switch for that before it was merged.
